versions.changelog: Browser cookies are now opt-in: nothing is read unless the user sets WATCH_BROWSER=auto (or a browser name) or passes --cookies <file>; a login wall fails with tag=download-auth and explains the opt-in. Install pinned to the v0.3.4 release.

Install pinned to the v0.3.3 release (SHA256-verified tarball) with Homebrew first; cookie policy made explicit: anonymous fetch first, browser cookies only on a login wall, read locally, never uploaded; WATCH_BROWSER=none opt-out; new 'What leaves the machine' section.
First ClawHub release: watch any video, get frames and a full transcript; transcription on Kyma
